title: GDPR-safe event tracking, daily fingerprinting, and monetization instrumentation (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Add a reusable frontend event logging utility for the exact Core Event names and required fields, safe for anonymous + authenticated sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend provides a single, reusable function/hook to log an event to the backend actor, including: event_name, country, page, device, metadata, and fingerprint when available.
Event names sent from the frontend match the provided snake_case values exactly.
Logging failures do not break the primary user flow (errors are caught and only logged to console/toast if needed).

file_operations.description: Define the Core Event name constants/types (snake_case values exactly as specified) to prevent renames/typos and standardize usage across the UI.

Implement a resilient event logger utility that builds the required payload fields (event_name, country, page, device, timestamp, metadata, optional fingerprint) and sends it via the backend actor; must catch/handle failures without breaking UX.
Create a hook that wraps the logger with app context (actor, cached country, daily fingerprint) and exposes a single call-site API usable from any component.
Ensure the event logging hook can obtain a working actor in both anonymous and authenticated modes and can call the backend logging capability without requiring user login.

requirements.summary: Implement daily rotating fingerprint hashing (hash(IP + user_agent + day)) and only send the derived fingerprint to the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend computes a daily fingerprint as hash(IP + user_agent + day) and sends only the hash to the backend (the app does not persist raw IP or raw user agent as stored tracking data).
Fingerprint value changes when the day changes.
If IP cannot be determined at runtime, the app degrades gracefully (still logs events, but without fingerprint and without anonymous usage enforcement).

file_operations.description: Implement daily fingerprint computation using Web Crypto hashing over (IP + userAgent + dayString), with in-memory/session caching of only the derived hash (no raw IP/UA persisted).
Add a hook to fetch IP at runtime (best-effort), compute the daily fingerprint, expose { fingerprint, isAvailable } and gracefully handle failures (returning no fingerprint).
Add a best-effort IP-based country detection helper that returns a country code when available and safely fails when not available (no raw IP persisted).

requirements.summary: Instrument the specified Caffeine AI Logic Flow by logging events at the exact user/system points (app load, country detection, VAT calc, reverse charge checks, invoice preview/download gating, AI explain, upgrade modal, Stripe click, payment success).
acceptanceCriteria: On first render of the app shell, frontend logs app_opened once per page load.
When country is auto-detected, frontend logs country_detected with metadata containing the country code (e.g., "DE").
When the user proceeds from Transaction Details into Results (VAT calculation), frontend logs vat_calculated once per calculation.
When reverse charge eligibility is evaluated as part of the flow, frontend logs reverse_charge_checked (only when the reverse charge condition is evaluated/true per the app’s logic).
When the user navigates into the invoice preview step, frontend logs invoice_previewed and increments anonymous invoices_count via the backend usage-limits API (when fingerprint is available).

When the user clicks to download the invoice (PDF/other download action), frontend logs invoice_downloaded on success; if blocked by the free limit it logs free_limit_reached and opens the upgrade UI.
When the user clicks to open VAT explanation from Results, frontend logs ai_explain_clicked.
Whenever an upgrade modal/screen is shown due to gating/upsell, frontend logs upgrade_cta_shown.
When the user clicks the Stripe checkout button, frontend logs stripe_checkout_clicked before redirect.
When the payment success page is reached, frontend logs payment_success once.

file_operations.description: On app shell mount, log app_opened once per page load; run best-effort country auto-detection and log country_detected with metadata containing the country code when available.
When the user clicks the Calculate VAT action, log vat_calculated once per calculation before advancing to Results.
When reverse charge logic is evaluated/allowed by the existing validation result, log reverse_charge_checked (ensure it only fires once per relevant evaluation).

When the user enters the invoice preview step, log invoice_previewed and (when fingerprint is available) call the backend anonymous usage increment capability; wire an upgrade-modal opener callback into Results for upsell instrumentation.

Instrument invoice download attempt/success vs free-limit gating: if blocked by anonymous free limit (when fingerprint is available), log free_limit_reached and open the upgrade UI; on successful download action, log invoice_downloaded.
When the user clicks Explain VAT from Results, log ai_explain_clicked before navigating to the explanation view.
When the modal becomes visible due to gating/upsell, log upgrade_cta_shown exactly once per open.
Log stripe_checkout_clicked immediately before starting checkout session creation/redirect.
On payment success page mount, log payment_success once (in addition to existing query invalidation).

requirements.summary: Replace upgrade/limit-reached messaging with Germany-optimized English copy and show it when free limit is reached during invoice download gating; instrument upgrade_cta_shown.
acceptanceCriteria: When free_limit_reached is triggered, the UI shows a modal/screen with English copy equivalent to: Headline: "You’ve reached your free limit"; Body: "Germany has strict VAT rules. With the Pro plan, your invoices stay correct, audit-ready, and up to date."; CTA: "Unlock unlimited invoices".
The modal appearance is instrumented as upgrade_cta_shown.
The upgrade CTA navigates to the /upgrade page (existing behavior) and does not break the current flow.

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated limit-reached modal using existing dialog primitives that displays the specified Germany-optimized English copy and routes the CTA to /upgrade; ensure opening is instrumented as upgrade_cta_shown.
Wire the new LimitReachedModal into the invoice download gating path so it is shown when the free limit is reached (and ensure free_limit_reached is logged when blocking occurs).

requirements.summary: Add an inline upsell under the VAT result in Results with Germany-optimized English copy; button opens upgrade UI and logs upgrade_cta_shown.
acceptanceCriteria: Results view renders an inline upsell block below the VAT result with English copy equivalent to: "Note: Cross-border EU business may require reverse-charge rules. Pro users get automatic checks and explanations."
Inline upsell includes a clear button (English) that opens the upgrade flow (modal and/or routes to /upgrade).
Clicking the inline upsell button logs upgrade_cta_shown.

file_operations.description: Render an inline upsell block under the VAT result with the specified English copy and an Upgrade button; on click, log upgrade_cta_shown and open the upgrade UI (via a callback prop).
Pass a Results prop/callback that opens the existing UpgradeModal so the inline upsell can trigger the upgrade flow without introducing new routes.

requirements.summary: Add AI explanation paywall messaging (English) for gated explanation/export actions; log ai_explain_clicked on engagement and upgrade_cta_shown when paywall is shown.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user engages with the VAT explanation feature, the click is logged as ai_explain_clicked.

If the user is blocked by plan gating for explanation-related premium actions, the UI presents an English paywall message equivalent to: "Why is VAT applied here? Pro explains the legal basis, rate, and exceptions in plain language." with an upgrade button.
Showing the paywall logs upgrade_cta_shown, and the upgrade button routes to /upgrade or opens the upgrade modal.

file_operations.description: Create a paywall dialog component for explanation-related premium actions showing the specified English copy and an upgrade button that routes to /upgrade; instrument paywall open as upgrade_cta_shown.
Replace the non-Pro PDF export toast with the new paywall dialog; ensure showing the paywall logs upgrade_cta_shown while preserving Pro behavior for premium actions.
Ensure the Explain VAT entry action from Results logs ai_explain_clicked (if not already handled by the flow instrumentation) before navigating to the explanation view.

requirements.summary: Update pricing presentation to Germany-optimized plans and add micro-trust text across upgrade surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrade page shows Free plan as "5 invoices per month" and maintains Starter at €5/month and Pro at €12/month (no price range).
Upgrade modal reflects the same pricing (Pro shows €12/month, not a range).
Upgrade page includes micro-trust text in English: "GDPR-compliant • No signup required • No ads".

file_operations.description: Update plan pricing display to Free: 5 invoices per month, Starter: €5/month, Pro: €12/month (no range), and add the micro-trust text "GDPR-compliant • No signup required • No ads" in the upgrade page layout.
Align modal pricing presentation with the upgrade page (Starter €5/month, Pro €12/month) and remove any Pro price ranges.
